source.title: Call for Applicants - WCAT Members (October 2018)
source.content:
The WCA Competition Announcement Team (WCAT) is seeking members to help them with our mission of announcing competitions! 

**The qualities of members we are seeking include:**
- A sense of detail. 
- Service mindedness.
- Sticking to protocol, and can help your fellow Delegates announce their competition in a reasonable time.
- Familiarity with the regulations and WCA Competition Policies.

The expected workload is 4-6 hours per week. More info of the policy of WCAT can be found here: [WCA Competition Announcement Policy Version 2.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/Competition%20Announcement.pdf)

<!-- break -->

**As a WCAT member you would work on the following tasks:**
- Reviewing and announcing competition submissions with accuracy and correctness.
- Handling change requests to competitions.
- Training Delegates to properly utilize the tools that WCA has for them.
- Partake in frequent votes for competition items that need approval.

**Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**
- A brief personal introduction.
- Summary of activities done for the WCA.
- Ambitions for the WCAT and why you are seeking to join.

Applications are open now until **November 5th 2018 23:59 UTC** to anyone interested in applying! The candidacy document must be sent to Henrik Aagaard (henrikthedane@gmail.com)

Please pass this information on to anyone in your community that you believe would be a good fit for this new team. You do not need to have any current position inside the WCA to be considered. 


Thank you!

translation.title: WCA 比赛公告团队成员招募（2018 年 10 月）
translation.content:
WCA 比赛公告团队（WCAT）正在招募新成员，一起完成比赛公告工作！

**我们希望成员具备以下条件：**

- 注重细节。
- 乐于服务他人。
- 遵守工作流程，能够帮助代表在合理时间内公布比赛。
- 熟悉 WCA 规则和比赛政策。

预计每周需投入 4–6 小时。关于 WCAT 的政策，详情见《[WCA 比赛公告政策 2.0 版](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/Competition%20Announcement.pdf)》。

<!-- break -->

**WCAT 成员的工作包括：**

- 准确审核并公布提交的比赛申请。
- 处理比赛信息的修改申请。
- 培训代表正确使用 WCA 提供的工具。
- 经常就需要批准的比赛事项参与投票。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：**

- 简短的自我介绍。
- 为 WCA 所做工作的总结。
- 对 WCAT 工作的设想，以及申请加入的原因。

申请面向所有有兴趣的人开放，截止时间为 **2018 年 11 月 5 日 23:59 UTC**。请将材料发送给 Henrik Aagaard（henrikthedane@gmail.com）。

如果你认为社区中有人适合加入这个新团队，请把消息转告他们。申请人无须目前已在 WCA 任职。

谢谢大家！
